name: agent-a11y-scanner
description: Standalone Playwright + axe-core scan engine (core.mjs), with two callers: the scheduled CLI (scan.mjs) and the on-demand live scan server (server.mjs). Deliberately separate from the viewer: a full scheduled run takes 3-5 minutes and must never live in an HTTP request — but a single live scan is fast enough to serve one on demand.
